visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long pink hair sits on a gray sofa, holding a clear glass of tea with both hands. She wears a light pink floral-patterned dress and has a small white fluffy dog resting calmly on her lap. The background shows a wooden bookshelf filled with items and a professional studio light stand in the corner. (2) A man in a green t-shirt and black shorts walks through a doorway into a modern living and dining area. He gestures with his hands while looking towards the camera, expressing a skeptical facial expression. The room is bright with minimalist decor, a gray stone wall, and wooden furniture. (3) The man stands behind a kitchen counter where seven colorful bags of Madam Afternoon Tea are lined up. He picks up a white bag with orange accents labeled 'Passion Fruit Apple Oolong Tea,' inspecting the texture of the packaging while speaking to the audience with a curious look. (4) A close-up shot shows the man's hands placing a small tea bag into a tall clear glass. He moves the glass under a sleek, modern Oasis water faucet featuring a digital interface. Clear water flows into the glass as he smiles and gives a thumbs-up gesture toward the camera lens. (5) The man takes a long sip of the golden tea, his eyes widening in a surprised yet pleased expression. He holds the glass up against the light to show the clarity of the beverage. The setting is a well-lit modern kitchen with a blurred living room in the background. (6) The man sits at a table with the tea bags again, pointing at them while looking directly at the camera with a confident smile. Subtitles and graphics showing promotional prices appear at the bottom. He takes another sip of the tea and makes a concluding gesture with his fingers.
